title.zh-CN: 边扫描边浏览，更流畅的空间清理体验
title.en: Browse while scanning, with smoother disk cleanup

items.zh-CN: 磁盘扫描现在会逐步显示已完成的空间分布，等待完整结果时也能浏览已扫描内容；停止扫描后仍可查看本次已完成的部分。
items.en: Disk scans now reveal completed portions of the usage map as they progress. You can browse scanned content before the full result is ready and retain partial results after stopping.

items.zh-CN: 改善大量文件扫描、扫描恢复和结果整理时长时间无进展的问题，减少未变化结果的重复读取，局部刷新时继续保留其他目录。
items.en: Improved long pauses during large scans, recovery, and result preparation, with fewer repeated reads of unchanged results and other folders preserved during targeted refreshes.

items.zh-CN: 扫描过程与原有扇形空间图融为一体，动效可稳定续播，完成后平滑进入结果；浏览目录时保持当前位置和清理篮。
items.en: Scanning blends into the existing sunburst map with animations that resume consistently and transition smoothly into results, while preserving your folder position and cleanup basket.

items.zh-CN: 重新整理磁盘扫描页面的导航与操作，在较窄窗口中也能切换空间图和列表、搜索与排序，并保留拖拽加入清理篮及删除动效。
items.en: Disk scan navigation and actions are easier to use in narrower windows, including map/list switching, search, and sorting, with drag-to-basket interactions and deletion animations retained.

items.zh-CN: 快速清理可展开查看来源与大小，并选择需要保留的位置；废纸篓默认不选，确认前会明确显示清理范围与预计释放空间。
items.en: Quick Cleanup now lets you inspect sources and sizes and choose locations to keep. Trash is unchecked by default, and confirmation clearly shows the selected scope and estimated space savings.

items.zh-CN: 首页优先展示当前问题与处理入口，跨天仍在持续的问题不会再被误报为已经恢复。
items.en: The home page prioritizes current problems and relevant actions, and ongoing issues that cross midnight are no longer incorrectly reported as resolved.

items.zh-CN: 应用中心在较长列表中保持浏览顺序，应用与后台任务的关联更准确，进程详情中的运行时间和状态会及时更新。
items.en: The application center keeps long lists stable while browsing, improves app-to-background-task associations, and refreshes runtime and status in process details.

items.zh-CN: 可以查看阻止休眠的任务、原因与电源状态，并暂时忽略计划中的任务提醒；工具箱优先展示可用、收藏和最近使用的工具，功能限制说明更清楚。
items.en: Inspect tasks preventing sleep, their reasons, and power status, and temporarily dismiss reminders for planned tasks. The toolbox prioritizes available, favorite, and recently used tools with clearer explanations of limitations.
